_comment: Exact English and Japanese status phrases. Japanese generates CP932 (observed rt.command on RTX830/1210) and UTF-8 (compatibility). Never infer current status from substring/history. Trailing ASCII period and whitespace are normalized by runtime. Preserve firmware spelling 継. Existing legacy phrases retained; extra English/PPTP variants need evidence before addition.
